svg.title: Uploads or Connectors
svg.desc: An uploaded file is a snapshot that goes stale when the source changes, so replace it by removing the old file first; information that changes often comes through a connector or a synced Google Doc in a private Project, and connectors reach only what your account can open, ask before sending or deleting by default and store retrieved data with the chat.
svg.text: Stable reference gets uploaded; changing data gets connected.
Remove the old file before adding the new
Connector, or a synced Google Doc
Asks before send or delete, by
